newsitem.title: UK: Ventspils says gasoil pipe may close due full tank.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils says gasoil pipe may close due full tank.

text.p: The gas oil pipeline feeding Latvia's Ventspils port is expected to shut later on Thursday because tanks at the terminal are nearly full and the port is closed due to high winds, a port spokesman said.
He said winds of 16 metres/second on Wednesday night had increased to 22 metres/second on Thursday and the port "would not open according to the forecast at least until tomorrow."
He said the terminal's gas oil tanks currently held 142,000 tonnes out of a total capacity of 150,000 tonnes and the pipeline would probably have to be closed later in the day.
But the crude oil pipeline was not expected to close because there was still plenty of spare storage space and two tankers were waiting in the roads for the port to reopen.
